claims.content: To allow the Auctioneer to review and analyze SKU-level auction performance metrics, including inventory aging, eligibility status, and financial summaries.

goal.raw_text: To allow the Auctioneer to review and analyze SKU-level auction performance metrics, including inventory aging, eligibility status, and financial summaries.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The user must be logged into the Auction Administration system as an 'Auctioneer'.
The Auctioneer must have navigated to and be viewing the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' page.
The Auctioneer accesses the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' page from the Auction Admin Main Menu to review SKU-level auction performance data.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer accesses the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' page from the Auction Admin Main Menu to review SKU-level auction performance data.

claims.content: The system displays the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' interface, which includes filter options such as 'Retail Category', 'Prod_Type', 'Material_Type', 'Brand', and 'Buyer'.
The Auctioneer selects desired criteria from the drop-down lists (e.g., 'Gemstone', 'Ring') to narrow the search results.
The Auctioneer clicks the 'Submit' button to execute the query based on the selected filters.

The system retrieves and displays a list of SKUs matching the criteria in a grid format, showing columns for 'Last Sale Date', 'Open PO', 'Product Type', 'Cost', 'GM/FE', 'Auction Available', and color-coded inventory counts (White, Red).

The system automatically calculates and displays summary statistics at the bottom of the report, including 'SKU Count', 'SKUs with no image', 'Auction Available piece count', 'Auction Available extended cost', and 'Auction Available Max Unit Costs'.
If the Auctioneer selects the 'Show Items without Image' radio button, the system filters the results to display only SKUs that do not have an associated image.
If the Auctioneer selects the 'Show Items with No Location' radio button, the system filters the results to display only SKUs that are missing location data.
If the Auctioneer selects the 'Show Items with Location' radio button, the system filters the results to display only SKUs that have valid location data.
The Auctioneer may choose to order the displayed results by specific columns such as 'Last Sale Date', 'Open PO', or 'Product Type' by selecting the corresponding sort options.
If the Auctioneer attempts to create an auction with the same starting and ending date/time, the system will display an error message and highlight (color-code) the offending data.
The system displays a filtered list of SKUs matching the Auctioneer's selected criteria in the results grid.
A 'Summary Section' is displayed below the results, containing calculated metrics based on the user's chosen criteria.
The Summary Section includes the total 'SKU Count' for the filtered results.
The Summary Section includes the count of 'SKUs Missing Images'.
The Summary Section includes the count of 'SKUs with No/Unsellable Locations'.
The Summary Section includes the 'Auction Available Piece Count'.
The Summary Section includes the 'Auction Available Extended Cost'.
The Summary Section includes the 'Auction Available Average Unit Cost'.
The Summary Section includes the 'Auction Available MAXIMUM Unit Cost' (highest single unit cost).
